name: Flohmarkt in der Markt- und Eventhalle

rhythm.en: On single weekends, roughly once a month

facts: indoors in the Markt- und Eventhalle at Wismar's Alter Hafen
an outdoor area of the same size next door is used over the summer months
runs whatever the weather, all year round
most dates run over two days
the hall is step-free and about five minutes' walk from the station and bus station
at least 500 paid parking spaces at the hall
the organiser has run the market itself since July 2019
dealers register online or on paper; pitch prices are set per event
notes: The organiser publishes a 2026 date list — 3 and 4 October and 31 October to 1 November fall in this window — but no visitor opening hours and no entry fee anywhere on its site, its trader page, its market rules or its dates PDF, so `opening` is omitted and `fee` is null. Nothing after 1 November 2026 is listed and no 2027 dates are up. The hall's address, floor area, parking and walking distance come from the same organiser's Markt- und Eventhalle page; flohmarkt-wismar.de is the organiser's own domain and serves this same page. Coordinates from Nominatim for the Markthalle at Stockholmer Straße 4.

description.de: An einzelnen Wochenenden, meist zwei Tage lang, in der Markt- und Eventhalle am Alten Hafen — 1.200 Quadratmeter Hallenfläche, im Sommer dazu das Freigelände nebenan. Findet bei jedem Wetter statt, das ganze Jahr. Barrierefrei, fünf Minuten vom Bahnhof, mindestens 500 Parkplätze.
description.en: On single weekends, usually across two days, in the Markt- und Eventhalle at the old harbour — 1,200 square metres of hall floor, with the outdoor area next door used in summer. It runs whatever the weather, all year. Step-free, five minutes from the station, at least 500 parking spaces.
